titles.title: It's time to do the things I used to do

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
It’s time to do the things that I used to do
Until my stagnant spirit begins to move
No one can do it for me I have to choose
So I’m asking help me God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
There's only one thing really worth living for
This is the one thing David did that’s for sure
It’s all about beholding Your beauty Lord
So I’m asking help me God

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I return with all of my heart
I return to my first love

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
You say "return with all of your heart"
You say "return to your first love"

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines: Help return to our first love
